title: How to inject insulin
what: You inject insulin under your skin yourself with an insulin pen. It is easy if you do it the same way every time.
why: For diabetes, when your doctor has prescribed insulin.
duration: the injection itself takes 1 to 2 minutes
tell_doctor: If your blood sugar is often too low or too high
If lumps appear at injection sites
If you have trouble seeing the dose window on the pen

prepare.title: Insulin
prepare.text: Keep spare insulin in the fridge, not the freezer. The pen you are using now is usually kept at room temperature. Check the leaflet.

prepare.title: Needles
prepare.text: A new needle for each injection. Put used needles in a sturdy jar with a lid.

prepare.title: Dose
prepare.text: Your doctor sets the dose and timing. Do not change the plan on your own.

steps: Wash your hands and check the insulin name and expiry date
For cloudy insulin, gently roll the pen in your hands and tip it 10 to 20 times
Attach a new needle and dial 2 units into the air. A drop at the tip means the pen works
Choose a spot: belly, thigh, upper arm, or buttock. Move a little away from the last spot each time
Insert the needle straight in and press the button all the way
Wait 10 seconds, then pull the needle out
Remove the needle and throw it in the jar
feel: A thin needle prick that you barely feel
Sometimes a drop of blood or a small bruise
after: Write down your dose and blood sugar in your log
Change injection spots, so lumps do not form
Always carry something sweet in case of low blood sugar
red_flags: Shaking, sweating, strong hunger, or confusion: eat something sweet and check your sugar
If someone is unconscious or having a seizure: call emergency services. Do not put anything in their mouth

faq.a: No. Inject into clean skin. This lowers the risk of infection and dose mistakes.

faq.q: What if I forgot an injection?
faq.a: Do not inject a double dose. Check your sugar and follow the plan your doctor gave you. If you have no plan, call your doctor.

reminders.text: Time for your insulin. New needle, 2 units into the air, your dose, then wait 10 seconds.
